evidence_required: A policy table (field class x behaviour x rationale), a break-glass procedure, and two scenario walk-throughs.

marking.criterion: Policy table splits fields by ownership and risk (invariants auto-revert, tunables alert with exemption, admin state via lifecycle)
Break-glass: who, scoped exemption object, expiry <= 24 h, audit record, mandatory follow-up PR; single writer per field and oscillation alert
Two scenario walk-throughs showing the policy's behaviour, including one incident tuning and one harmful hand edit

title: Drift policy and break-glass for the ORION fabric
